texts.preamble: Syed Sohel Syed Mehmood vs The Commissioner Of Police Aurangabad ... on 15 May, 2024 In The High Court Of Judicature At Bombay Bench At Aurangabad Anticipatory Bail Application No. 734 Of 2024 Syed Sohel Syed Mehmood Versus The Commissioner Of Police Aurangabad And Another Mr. A. R. Borulkar, Advocate for the Applicant Mr. V. M. Kagane, App for the Respondents/State Coram : R. M. Joshi, J. (Vacation Court) Dated : 15th May, 2024 Per Court :- 1. Heard. 2.
texts.facts: The learned counsel for the applicant submits that the contraband articles i.e. gutkha, panmasala are already seized and nothing is to be recovered at the instance of the Applicant. Applicant apprehends arrest in connection with Crime No. 25/2024 registered with Jinsi Police Station, Dist. Aurangabad for the offences punishable under Section 328, 273, 188 of IPC, 26(1), 26(2) (iv), 27(3)(d), 27(3)(e), 30(2)(a), 59 of Food Safety and Standard Act and 7(2) of the Cigarette and other Tobacco Products (Prohibition on Advertisement and Regulation of Trade and Commerce, Production, Supply and Distribution) Act.
texts.arguments: He further submits, on instructions, that the Applicant has no criminal history. 2. It is the contention of the learned counsel for the applicant that the name of the applicant does not appear in the first information report to be the person from whose custody the contraband articles are seized. The solemn statement is made that he has no criminal history 904.aba734.24.odt 1 of 2 and he never involved in similar crime. Learned APP opposed the application by contending that during the course of the investigation name of the applicant has revealed as supplier of the contraband articles and hence, he is not entitled for anticipatory bail.
texts.petitioner_arguments: 2. It is the contention of the learned counsel for the applicant that the name of the applicant does not appear in the first information report to be the person from whose custody the contraband articles are seized. The solemn statement is made that he has no criminal history 904.aba734.24.odt 1 of 2 and he never involved in similar crime.
texts.respondent_arguments: He further submits, on instructions, that the Applicant has no criminal history. Learned APP opposed the application by contending that during the course of the investigation name of the applicant has revealed as supplier of the contraband articles and hence, he is not entitled for anticipatory bail.
